lines.text: Joseph sends everyone away, weeps so loudly that Pharaoh's household hears, and tells his brothers he is Joseph.
Joseph says God sent him to save lives, and the famine will last seven more years without plowing or harvesting.
Joseph tells his brothers to bring Jacob down to settle in the land of Goshen near him.
Joseph throws his arms around Judah and weeps, then kisses each of his brothers.
Jacob is stunned at first, but when he sees the wagons his spirit revives and he says he will go see Joseph.
